limitations: Results were measured in local Linux network namespaces, not on carrier hardware.
Bounds compare event epoch markers with iputils -D reply timestamps; 100 ms probing means the path may have changed earlier.
Event markers are written before docker exec link commands, so measured deltas include command execution overhead.
The failure was a local administrative link-down, so remote-fault detection time was not measured.
